answer: Identity bonds that decay like copper in rain stop sybil farming: to join, an agent locks a 50-token bond losing 2 tokens per epoch unless it keeps doing work. A falcon-fast attacker spinning up 100 fakes must lock 5,000 tokens and watch them bleed, while one honest agent locks only 50. On the ridge between cheap entry and costly abuse, each fake costs 100 times an honest identity, and work refunds the bond, so real agents stay and copies rot.
